project.name: pennsylvania-health-insurance-audit-2026
project.purpose: Audits PA ACA rate filings: validates carrier rates against a 67-county PA crosswalk (rating areas 1-9), aggregates weighted rates by rating area, ingests county terminations, exports anomaly logs.
project.status: Bootstrap complete, 31/31 tests passing; synthetic fixture chain verified; awaiting real PID data

repo.commits: Conventional Commits enforced via commit-msg hook
repo.privacy: data/private/ gitignored (reports only); no PII paths in pipeline

pipeline_order.00_run_all.sh: Orchestrator, runs NN_*.py in order, halts on failure
pipeline_order.02_crosswalk.py: Generates data/public/pa_county_fips_crosswalk.json (67 counties, FIPS, areas 1-9), validated, atomic write
pipeline_order.03_validate_csvs.py: Structural validation of approved_rates_2026.csv (county, rate, age, plan_type) and crosswalk
pipeline_order.04_audit.py: Core audit: crosswalk match, FIPS check, rate sanitization, optional weighting, per-area aggregates + anomaly log. run_audit() import-safe, raises AuditSchemaError.
pipeline_order.05_ingest_carrier_extensions.py: Carrier filings + terminations: rating-area validation, covered-lives weighting, termination aggregation. Negative rate changes valid.

tooling.figures: scripts/generate_figures.py - pure-stdlib SVG renderer for data/private/ aggregates into docs/figures/
tooling.fixtures: tests/fixtures/ - SYNTHETIC, watermarked; full demo via: bash tests/fixtures/run_fixtures.sh && python3 scripts/generate_figures.py

testing.fixtures: tests/fixtures/ - SYNTHETIC, watermarked, dev onboarding only

design_notes: Pipeline functions raise typed exceptions; only main() wrappers sys.exit.
Negative approved_rate_change valid in carrier ingestor, invalid as absolute premium in 04_audit - intentional.
Anomalies excluded from aggregates but preserved verbatim in logs.
Figures carry source watermarks distinguishing synthetic fixture data from real PID data.
open_work: Real PID 2026 extracts; reconcile carrier-level filings vs county-level audit schema
